privacy_note: Stores only safe metadata: hashed sample IDs, document types, boolean field presence, error categories. No names, no business numbers, no raw OCR text, no document images.
sample_id_scheme: sha256(file_bytes)[:12] -- stable, non-reversible without the file

failures_before.detail: OCR returned the row as two boxes ('성' / '명:<name>'). The extractor matched labels against whole lines, so the label '성명' never existed as a contiguous string.
failures_before.downstream_consequence: Field silently unresolved; no evidence, no wrong value.

failures_before.detail: Primary department box split into '전' / '공:<primary>'; the secondary '복 수 전 공 :<second major>' stayed intact, so first-match returned the SECOND MAJOR.
failures_before.downstream_consequence: Confidently wrong value in a populated field.

failures_before.detail: Letter-spaced document title split into 5 boxes with one mis-recognized ('5명'), so the exact-substring title signal '재학증명서' never matched and the TYPE signal (weight 5.0) was lost.
failures_before.downstream_consequence: Type became UNKNOWN, which disables the entire extractor registry for this document -- every field lost.

failures_after.detail: The university name appears only in the signature block as letter-spaced '경 / 북 / 대 / 학 / 교' adjacent to overlapping seal text. The row tail '총' is not a valid institution, so the candidate is rejected rather than repaired.
failures_after.downstream_consequence: Unresolved -> human review. Safe failure, not a confident wrong value.

failures_before.detail: is_meaningful_text() was evaluated once over the concatenated document text. A 91-character digital text page on page 1 satisfied the gate, so the whole document skipped OCR and the scanned page 2 contributed 0 characters.
failures_before.downstream_consequence: Every field on the scanned page was lost with no error, no warning, and no review flag.

failures_before.detail: The 'next line' fallback walked a single flattened list of all pages' lines, so a bare label at the bottom of page 1 paired with the first text of page 2.
failures_before.downstream_consequence: A fabricated value with evidence citing two different pages.

after.note: PARTIAL -- orientation retry helps but does not recover the document type. Rotation remains a documented limitation.

failures_before.detail: No orientation handling of any kind; PaddleOCR's use_doc_orientation_classify/use_textline_orientation were both hard-disabled.
